hero.title: Ruang Madina
hero.copy: We design neat, functional, and peaceful interiors—tailor-made to embrace how your family truly lives.

trust.customSub: Tailored to your space and lifestyle

projects.title: Details crafted
projects.desc: Not merely picturesque in photos. Every corner is crafted to fulfill real daily needs, from bustling mornings to quiet gatherings.
projects.photoNote: Inspiration imagery reflects design intent and craftsmanship character. Client projects are presented respecting privacy.

process.title: Clarity from the start,
process.desc: Six thoughtful steps to keep budget, dimensions, and project timeline precisely on track.

steps.title: Estimate your kitchen set transparently
steps.text: Per linear meter, five classes, fixed price.

steps.title: Design finalized before production
steps.text: Clients review and refine the full design visualization before manufacturing begins.

steps.title: Measured twice
steps.text: Initial estimate based on your provided dimensions, followed by thorough on-site measurements before fabrication.

steps.title: Written timeline as a firm commitment
steps.text: Design phase ~7 working days; room fabrication 30 working days once design is approved.

steps.title: Pricing includes full installation
steps.text: Any item calculated separately is transparently stated upfront (countertop, backsplash, lighting, delivery).

steps.title: Unified with Madina Build
steps.text: Interior can be conceived seamlessly alongside architecture, preventing costly retrofits.

principles.kicker: A good space is about much more than appearance.
principles.title: It calms your routine,

items.title: Taharah (Purity & Cleanliness)
items.text: Practical ablution areas and washbasins, easy-to-clean kitchen surfaces, discreet closed storage

items.title: Mahram & Privacy
items.text: Thoughtful zoning between guest reception and private family areas; separate bedrooms for boys and girls

items.title: Facilitating Worship
items.text: Dedicated prayer corner aligned with the Qibla, integrated storage for prayer garments and mats

items.title: Enduring & Quality Materials
items.text: Safe, sustainable, long-lasting materials with detailed specifications stated from day one

items.title: Tawazun (Balance & Moderation)
items.text: Functionality first, unpretentious elegance, tailored strictly to real needs and sensible budgets

services.title: Starting from one room,
services.desc: We guide you in understanding the scope and cost components before breaking ground.

items.title: Kitchen set
items.basisNote: Upper and lower cabinetry calculated separately
items.exampleText: 4 m wall kitchen = 8 linear meters (4 m lower + 4 m upper) = IDR 20M (Essential).
items.scope: Includes cabinetry and on-site installation. Countertop, backsplash, and sink quoted separately.
items.waQuery: Hello Ruang Madina, I would like to consult about a kitchen set.

items.title: Custom furniture
items.basisNote: Customized to your exact space dimensions and layout

customPrices.title: Other custom units
customPrices.desc: TV backdrops, credenzas, study desks, and partitions quoted based on physical dimensions.

items.exampleText: Frontal area is calculated from height × width of the front wardrobe elevation.
items.scope: Cost includes on-site assembly and seamless built-in installation.
items.waQuery: Hello Ruang Madina, I would like to consult about custom furniture.

items.title: Interior design package
items.basis: Per room or total floor area

designPrices.areaDesc: Scaled according to total building floor area.

items.exampleText: Photorealistic 3D renders, spatial floor plans, technical working drawings, and budget bill of quantities.
items.scope: Design planning can be conducted independently before proceeding to physical production.
items.waQuery: Hello Ruang Madina, I would like to consult about an interior design package.

calculator.heading: Have a kitchen wall around
calculator.desc: Slide to give us an initial idea. Final estimation follows accurate site measurements, configuration, and design details.
calculator.note: Final investment is not determined solely by cabinet length. Our team will transparently break down all components upon understanding your needs.
calculator.waQueryWithLength: Hello Ruang Madina, I would like to consult about home interior with an estimated cabinet length of {{length}} meters.
calculator.waQueryDefault: Hello Ruang Madina, I would like to consult about home interior.

about.title: Not merely filling spaces.
about.p1: Ruang Madina is the interior and custom furniture division of Madina Build. We believe a peaceful home begins by listening: how you move, store, gather, and rest.
about.p2: From there, we translate your lifestyle into spaces that feel serene, personal, and enduring for years to come.

closing.title: The space you envision,
closing.desc: Send photos and rough dimensions of your room. Our team will help map out the next steps.
closing.note: No technical architectural drawings required to get started.

footer.tagline: Interiors that are neater, purposeful, and deeply connected to how you live.
